generatedNote: headless bot diagnostics — not player pass rates

goal_greedy.desc: 1-step lookahead on a cloned state: maximise 1000×goal progress (capped by what is left) + 300×won + 0.05×points; ties by bot RNG. NOTE: the clone includes the refill stream, so the lookahead sees the real refills of that step (a peeking advantage a player does not have)

random_legal.desc: uniform random choice among Core.listMoves (bot RNG = mulberry32(hash(strategy|seed)), independent of game streams)
